introHtml: Custom unisex golf pencils are a practical giveaway for any golf event, fitting comfortably in any hand regardless of gender. Whether you're stocking pro shop counters or assembling tournament swag bags, these pencils offer a low-cost, high-utility branding option that appeals to all players. Imprint your logo on the barrel using foil stamping or pad printing for a clean, professional look that lasts through 18 holes. Perfect for corporate outings, charity scrambles, or league play, they ensure your brand is part of every scorecard.
